claims.claim_text: Bread and Roses does not pretend to know exactly how a transition from capitalism to socialism will ultimately play out.
Bread and Roses wants to build a socialist party that can take advantage of a crisis of legitimacy of capitalism when it surely arrives.
Popular mobilizations together with an elected socialist government would be able to create a rupture with the capitalist system.
